blocks.content: Congratulations on completing this path! Job well done!

You have successfully:

- Navigated to the Alert rules page and started a new rule
- Named the rule and built a query that tells Grafana what data to watch
- Configured a condition that decides when the alert fires
- Organized the rule in a folder and added labels for routing
- Set how often Grafana checks the condition and how long it must be true
- Chosen what happens when data is missing or returns an error
- Selected a contact point for notifications
- Saved the rule and confirmed it appears in the rules list
Your alert rule is now actively monitoring your data. When the condition stays true past the pending period, Grafana fires the alert and sends a notification to your contact point.

---

### Related paths

Consider taking the following paths after you complete this one:

- [Configure notification routing](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/notification-routing/) to control where different alerts go based on labels
- [Create a silence](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/create-silence/) to temporarily stop notifications
- [Configure a mute timing](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/configure-mute-timing/) to set recurring quiet windows
